versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Alibaba Super Resolution skill.
- Upscale and enhance video resolution using Alibaba Cloud's Super Resolution API.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV formats; input up to 2GB (or unlimited with OSS).
- CLI tool provided for video processing, job management, and bitrate customization.
- Includes error handling guidance and OSS configuration options.
- Default behaviors: balanced bitrate, 20-minute timeout, output link expires in 24 hours.
